title: Business with Gratitude and Human-Centered Venture
primary_theme: Backing Futurist Founders Before the Market Sees Their Value
founder_lessons: Develop awareness of where consumers and markets are heading, then build before the market catches up.
Use rapid iteration to gain conviction in the idea and how the market is responding.
Raise only enough capital to reach the next milestone and avoid valuations the company cannot grow into.
Choose early investors whose values and level of attention match the company you are building.
notable_quotes: founders are generally living in a world that's 10 years ahead of their time.
it's hard to be unhappy if you are grateful for what you have.
Founders have to really think about being measured in the beginning and not take on too much capital at too high of a valuation before they understand if they have a product that's working.
